title: Interpretable Fundus Image Classification via Ring-Based Retinal Vasculature Features
abstract: arXiv:2608.24723v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retinal fundus photography is widely used for screening and monitoring ocular diseases, but many modern classification pipelines rely on deep latent representations and provide limited interpretability. This study develops an interpretable fundus image classification framework based on a ring-structured representation of the retinal vasculature centered on the optic disc. The method quantifies vessel geometry, color appearance, oxygenation-related vascular appearance, and vessel--background entropy within concentric retinal regions. These physiologically motivated descriptors are derived from vessel masks, image intensities, and optical-density measurements and aggregated across rings to capture spatial variation in vascular properties. Using only quantitative vascular descriptors, the proposed method achieved strong classification performance across three public fundus datasets. translated_title: 基于环形视网膜血管特征的可解释眼底图像分类
translated_abstract: 眼底照相广泛用于眼部疾病的筛查和监测，但许多现代分类流程依赖深度潜在表示，且可解释性有限。本研究开发了一个基于以视盘为中心的环形视网膜血管结构的可解释眼底图像分类框架。该方法在同心视网膜区域内量化血管几何形状、颜色外观、与氧合相关的血管外观以及血管-背景熵。这些生理动机描述符来源于血管掩膜、图像强度和光学密度测量，并跨环聚合以捕捉血管属性的空间变化。仅使用定量血管描述符，所提方法在三个公共眼底数据集上取得了强分类性能。在HRF上，使用自动方法实现了91.1%的准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于环形视网膜血管几何、颜色和氧合特征的创新可解释眼底分类方法，无需深度学习，在多个数据集上达到高准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an interpretable fundus classification framework using ring-based retinal vasculature features, achieving high accuracy without deep learning.
